shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md && sed -n '1,500p' ../round-brief.md && git diff origin/main...HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json && git show origin/main:package.json | sed -n '1,35p' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"registry\\.test|hal-engine-tool-input-validation|validated by\" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,140p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Bump version for tool input validation" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
